profile.headline: Software Engineer for Stellar Science
profile.summary: Currently a software engineer for Stellar Science with 5+ years of diverse software experience, ranging from scientific computational software (C++, Python, parellel computing, Windows/Linux), embedded mission-critical real-time control system software (Embedded Linux, VxWorks, C, C++), UI design and development (Qt, C#, UNO, OpenGL), as well as DevOps Jenkins pipeline experience (Jenkins, Docker). Currently maintaining an active Secret Security Clearance.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.locationName: Salt Lake City, Utah, United States · On-site
positions.description:
Designed, developed, and integrated embedded antenna control software. Acted as a lead engineer over antenna software on a major program.

Responsibilities:
•    Architected and implemented a suite of real-time C++ 98, C++ 11, C++ 14, and C++ 17 microservices running on embedded Linux and VxWorks, managing intercommunication across up to five processors via DDS and proprietary Ethernet protocols.
•    Implemented full software control stacks for various antennas, RF amplifiers, RF receiver, and an INS/GPS navigation system over various I2C, serial and ethernet protocols.
•    Developed Ph.D. authored antenna control algorithms and independently debugged and validated them through simulation software, motion table field testing and statistical analysis.
•    Designed and tuned a software AGC (automatic gain control) algorithm for RF amplifier control, iterating through filter approaches and performing hardware characterization to resolve unexpected hardware behavior.
•    Led two antenna motion table tests, coordinating software, hardware, and systems teams to validate pointing and tracking performance.
•    Implemented simulation tools in Python to test hardware, including tools to simulate RF loss based on link budgets and antenna mis-pointing
•    Debugged on board with electrical and RF engineers using spectrum analyzers and oscilloscopes
•    Maintained unit test coverage using GoogleTest and GoogleMock, including advanced sequencing and callback injection patterns, using Valgrind and ThreadSanitizer throughout development. Achieved 90% code coverage
•    Acted as a COG/CAM (Cognizant Engineer/Cost Account Manager) over antenna software for a major program. This responsibility included staffing reports, earned value reporting, and system design/planning.

positions.title: Software Engineer Intern
positions.locationName: Salt Lake City, Utah, United States
positions.description:
Software engineering intern embedded within the Flat Panel X-ray detector hardware group, responsible for the team's CI/test infrastructure and developed software features.

Responsibilities:
•    Engineered a Jenkins-based automated test pipeline that compiled and ran code on upwards of hundreds of flat panels.
•    Implemented several hardware controls in C++ with C-exposed APIs, targeting both Windows and Embedded Linux (NVIDIA Jetson Board).
•    Helped implement and maintain a customer-exposed Qt GUI
•    Led migration of the codebase from C++14 to C++17, updating build configurations and modernizing language usage across the project.
